\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=400pt,paperheight=330pt,textwidth=320pt,textheight=210pt,top=30pt,left=40pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newif\ifStyleInline
\StyleInlinetrue
\newif\ifStyleTF
\newcount\StyleFormatted
\newwrite\StyleNodes
\newwrite\StyleEffects
\immediate\openout\StyleNodes=\jobname.nodes
\immediate\openout\StyleEffects=\jobname.effects
\def\StylePath{none}
\def\StyleSide{}
\@for\StyleCounter:=sharp,rounded,own-upper,own-lower,ancestor,top-active,top-feed,bottom-active,bottom-feed\do{%
  \expandafter\newcount\csname StyleCount@\StyleCounter\endcsname}
\@for\StyleCounter:=envA,envB,entryA,entryB\do{%
  \expandafter\newcount\csname StyleProfile@\StyleCounter\endcsname}
\@for\StyleCounter:=first,middle,last\do{%
  \expandafter\newcount\csname StylePiece@\StyleCounter\endcsname}
\long\def\StyleChoice#1#2{%
  \ifStyleInline\expandafter\@firstoftwo\else\expandafter\@secondoftwo\fi{#1}{#2}}
\long\def\StyleChooseTF#1#2{%
  \ifStyleTF\expandafter\@firstoftwo\else\expandafter\@secondoftwo\fi{#1}{#2}}
\def\StylePayload{before}
\def\StyleTokens{frozen}
\protected\def\StyleProtectedPayload#1{\StyleCheckValue{#1}}
\def\StyleCheckValue#1{%
  \edef\StyleSeen{#1}%
  \ifx\StyleSeen\StyleExpected\else
    \PackageError{style-test}{Payload evaluated at the wrong time}{Preserve PGF key order and entry capture binding.}%
  \fi}
\tikzset{
 p3/profile/.code 2 args={%
   \def\StyleKind{#1}\def\StyleEnvKind{env}%
   \ifx\StyleKind\StyleEnvKind
     \def\StyleExpected{after}\def\StyleExpectedTokens{\StyleTokens}%
   \else
     \def\StyleExpected{before}\def\StyleExpectedTokens{frozen}%
   \fi
   \ifx\StyleSide\@empty\else
     \ifnum\dte@k>\dte@eget{\StyleCutIndex}{d}\relax
       \edef\StylePath{\StyleSide-feed}%
     \else
       \edef\StylePath{\StyleSide-active}%
     \fi
   \fi
   \global\advance\csname StyleProfile@#1#2\endcsname by1\relax
   \global\advance\csname StyleCount@\StylePath\endcsname by1\relax
   \protected@write\StyleEffects{}{STYLE \StylePath/#1#2}},
 p3/set/.code={\def\StylePayload{after}},
 p3/value/.code={\StyleCheckValue{#1}},
 p3/tokens/.code={%
   \def\StyleSeenTokens{#1}%
   \ifx\StyleSeenTokens\StyleExpectedTokens\else
     \PackageError{style-test}{Braced payload tokens changed}{Do not fully expand the stored option list.}%
   \fi},
 p3/pair/.code={%
   \def\StylePair{#1}\def\StyleExpectedPair{tag{left,right}}%
   \ifx\StylePair\StyleExpectedPair\else
     \PackageError{style-test}{Braced comma value changed}{Preserve inner value braces.}%
   \fi},
 p3/run/.code={#1}
}
\tikzset{p3-envA/.style={p3/profile={env}{A},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 4pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}}
\def\StyleEnvA{\StyleChoice{p3/profile={env}{A},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 4pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}{p3-envA}}
\tikzset{p3-envB/.style={p3/profile={env}{B},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 3pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}}
\def\StyleEnvB{\StyleChoice{p3/profile={env}{B},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 3pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}{p3-envB}}
\tikzset{p3-entryA/.style={p3/profile={entry}{A},{p3/set},p3/value={before},p3/tokens={frozen},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{before}},dash pattern={on 2pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}}
\def\StyleEntryA{\StyleChoice{p3/profile={entry}{A},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 2pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}{p3-entryA}}
\tikzset{p3-entryB/.style={p3/profile={entry}{B},{p3/set},p3/value={before},p3/tokens={frozen},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{before}},dash pattern={on 5pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}}
\def\StyleEntryB{\StyleChoice{p3/profile={entry}{B},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on 5pt off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}{p3-entryB}}
\def\StyleEnvCurrent{\StyleEnvA}
\def\StyleEntryCurrent{\StyleEntryA}
\def\StyleSpaceA{\StyleChoice{ \StyleSpaceB }{\StyleSpaceB}}
\def\StyleSpaceB{\StyleChoice{ \StyleEnvCurrent }{\StyleEnvCurrent}}
\def\StyleEntryAlias{\StyleEntryCurrent}
\protected\def\StyleProtectedHead{\StyleEnvCurrent}
\def\StyleEmpty{}
\def\StyleSafeTF{\StyleChooseTF{\StyleEnvA}{\StyleEnvB}}
\def\StyleParameter#1{\StyleChoice{p3/profile={env}{B},{p3/set},p3/value={\StylePayload},p3/tokens={\StyleTokens},p3/pair={tag{left,right}},p3/run={\StyleProtectedPayload{\StylePayload}},dash pattern={on #1 off 2pt},dash phase=1pt,draw opacity=0.8}{p3-envB}}
\def\StyleConditionalTrue{\iftrue p3-envA\else p3-envB\fi}
\def\StyleConditionalFalse{\iffalse p3-envA\else p3-envB\fi}
\let\StyleOriginalName\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\StyleFormatted by1
  \protected@write\StyleNodes{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \StyleOriginalName{#1}}
\let\StyleOriginalSharp\dte@connector@sharp
\def\dte@connector@sharp{\def\StylePath{sharp}\StyleOriginalSharp}
\let\StyleOriginalRounded\dte@connector@rounded
\def\dte@connector@rounded{\def\StylePath{rounded}\StyleOriginalRounded}
\let\StyleOriginalVert\dte@drawvert
\def\dte@drawvert#1#2#3#4#5#6{%
  \ifnum\dte@k=\dte@ownd\relax
    \ifdim#1>0pt \def\StylePath{own-upper}\else\def\StylePath{own-lower}\fi
  \else\def\StylePath{ancestor}\fi
  \StyleOriginalVert{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}{#5}{#6}}
% Both private loop layouts expose the same boundary side and cut index.
\ifdefined\dte@foreach@owner
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\dte@foreach@owner\dte@prevbk\dte@draw@topcolumn}
    {\def\StyleSide{top}%
     \edef\StyleCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\numexpr\dte@piecenum-1\relax}}%
     \dte@foreach@owner\dte@prevbk\dte@draw@topcolumn}
    {}{\errmessage{Cannot observe top boundary}}
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\dte@foreach@owner\dte@curbk\dte@draw@bottomcolumn}
    {\def\StyleSide{bottom}%
     \edef\StyleCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\dte@piecenum}}%
     \dte@foreach@owner\dte@curbk\dte@draw@bottomcolumn}
    {}{\errmessage{Cannot observe bottom boundary}}
\else
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@prevbk\do}
    {\def\StyleSide{top}%
     \edef\StyleCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\numexpr\dte@piecenum-1\relax}}%
     \@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@prevbk\do}
    {}{\errmessage{Cannot observe top boundary}}
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@curbk\do}
    {\def\StyleSide{bottom}%
     \edef\StyleCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\dte@piecenum}}%
     \@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@curbk\do}
    {}{\errmessage{Cannot observe bottom boundary}}
\fi
\let\StyleOriginalPiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \global\advance\csname StylePiece@#1\endcsname by1\relax
  \StyleOriginalPiece{#1}}
\def\StyleRequire#1{%
  \ifnum\csname StyleCount@#1\endcsname>0\else
    \PackageError{style-test}{Missing style path #1}{The matrix must exercise this renderer path.}%
  \fi}
\def\StyleCheckMainBinding{%
  \ifnum\StyleProfile@envA=0\else\errmessage{Environment style bound too early}\fi
  \ifnum\StyleProfile@envB>0\else\errmessage{Late environment style was not applied}\fi
  \ifnum\StyleProfile@entryA>0\else\errmessage{Captured entry style was not applied}\fi
  \ifnum\StyleProfile@entryB=0\else\errmessage{Entry style bound too late}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifnum\StyleFormatted=61\relax\else
    \PackageError{style-test}{Entry formatting count changed}{All entries must be formatted once.}%
  \fi
  \ifdte@needrerun
    \typeout{STYLE-COVERAGE-PENDING}%
  \else
    \@for\StyleCounter:=sharp,rounded,own-upper,own-lower,ancestor,top-active,bottom-active\do{\expandafter\StyleRequire\expandafter{\StyleCounter}}%
    \@for\StyleCounter:=first,middle,last\do{%
      \ifnum\csname StylePiece@\StyleCounter\endcsname>0\else
        \PackageError{style-test}{Missing piece \StyleCounter}{Require first, middle and last pictures.}%
      \fi}
    % These cuts do not descend; the columns case covers genuine feeds.
    \ifnum\csname StyleCount@top-feed\endcsname=0\else\errmessage{Unexpected top feed}\fi
    \ifnum\csname StyleCount@bottom-feed\endcsname=0\else\errmessage{Unexpected bottom feed}\fi
    \typeout{STYLE-MATRIX-PASSED}%
  \fi
  \@for\StyleCounter:=sharp,rounded,own-upper,own-lower,ancestor,top-active,top-feed,bottom-active,bottom-feed\do{%
    \typeout{STYLE-PATH-\StyleCounter=\the\csname StyleCount@\StyleCounter\endcsname}}
  \@for\StyleCounter:=first,middle,last\do{%
    \typeout{STYLE-PIECE-\StyleCounter=\the\csname StylePiece@\StyleCounter\endcsname}}
  \typeout{STYLE-FORMATTED=\the\StyleFormatted}}
\makeatother
